title: The More the Better? A Comparison of Single- and Multi-Agent LLM Setups on a Financial Review Task
abstract: arXiv:2610.27488v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Practitioner guidance holds that a large language model reviews a document better when the work is divided among agents. We test a narrow form of it in a controlled comparison of single-agent and multi-agent setups on a financial task, reviewing credit assessment memos against requirements. One agent checks six requirements in one call. A team of three on the same model checks the same memo, two requirements each, in the same words, with no roles or later stage. Labels are known for every requirement on 300 synthetic memos, so misses and false alarms are measured separately. Two primary predictions are tested on four models at a Bonferroni-corrected level. Under an instruction to decide each requirement once, the team catches 0.08 to 0.10 more of the defects that carry an explanation on the three models whose single agent misses some, at the corrected level on two. It raises more false alarms on all four, at the corrected level on three.

translated_title: 越多越好吗？单智能体与多智能体大语言模型设置在金融审查任务上的比较
translated_abstract: 实践者指南认为，当工作在多个智能体之间进行分工时，大语言模型能更好地审查文档。我们在一项金融任务上——根据要求审查信用评估备忘录——通过对单智能体和多智能体设置进行受控比较，测试了这一观点的一种狭义形式。一个智能体在一次调用中检查六项要求；同一模型上的三个智能体组成的团队检查同一份备忘录，每个智能体检查两项要求，使用相同的措辞，没有角色分工或后续阶段。300份合成备忘录的每项要求都有已知标签，因此可以分别测量遗漏和误报。研究在四个模型上以Bonferroni校正后的显著性水平检验了两个主要预测。在要求对每项要求只做一次判断的指令下，在单智能体存在遗漏的三个模型上，团队多捕获了0.08到0.10的带有解释的缺陷，其中两个模型达到校正后的显著水平；而在所有四个模型上，团队都产生了更多误报，其中三个模型达到校正后的显著水平。
tldr: 该研究在金融审查任务上对单智能体与多智能体LLM设置进行受控比较，发现多智能体分工虽能多捕获约0.08至0.10的缺陷，但同时会带来更多误报，表明“智能体越多越好”并不总是成立。
en_tdlr: This study presents a controlled comparison of single- and multi-agent LLM setups on a financial review task, finding that while multi-agent division of labor catches 0.08 to 0.10 more defects, it also raises more false alarms, showing that "the more the better" does not always hold.
